main.limits: One fresh cache-disabled pair, four frontend/codegen workers, 30-second cap, no concurrent compiler/check workload. 5.773 to 5.778 seconds establishes no meaningful latency change; configured 5.660 seconds. Five-second/subsecond and 1-2MB targets remain unmet.

implementation.control_joins: Reserve edge copies; materialize differing/non-dominating or mutable lanes. Complete semantic assignment still runs. Tagged/demand/host/unowned-reference subtrees retain transport while siblings may share.
implementation.helper_results: Finished unwritten formal locals map result words to original logical inputs. Alias stores/loads disappear; packet extents and semantic owner/effect events remain intact.
implementation.zero_sources: Only value-less completions, terminated values and static callable placeholders share one unwritten i32 local per function. Writable flags, caches and counters remain independent.
implementation.mutable_origins: One set per Generator. Root prefix cursor, full loop carriers and demand ready/results marked once. Root token remaps are recorded. Export switches clear namespace state. Failed helper generators own and destroy their state.
